description: The catalogue of everything this platform publishes: each dataset with its id, title, topic, publisher, licence, coverage, record count, refresh cadence and the page it is published on; each mirrored statistical series with its id, publisher, unit and period range; and the three official registers mirrored weekly. Call this first when you do not yet know which dataset, series or register holds the figure you need — get_series and get_register take their ids from here.
name: list_datasets
title: Dataset catalogue
